steps.why: Art. 273(1) OR requires a challenge to a landlord’s termination to be submitted to the conciliation authority within 30 days after receipt of the termination. The existing workflow preserves the deadline, but does not explicitly require filing the challenge; this step should follow the receipt/deadline check and precede the formal and merits review.
